generation.explanation: The sine graph is wavy because sine is literally the vertical height of a point moving around a unit circle. As the angle θ increases at a steady rate, that point goes up, comes back down, goes below the axis, and rises again—so the y-coordinate oscillates smoothly between −1 and 1, tracing out the familiar wave.
